reviews.t: Une bonne boulangerie, à l’image des autres boutiques de la chaîne. Celle-ci est bien située, à proximité immédiate de la Gare de Lyon, pratique donc pour prendre une collation à emporter avant un trajet en train. De très nombreux produits sont proposés à la vente, sucrés (viennoiseries, pâtisseries, communes ou plus originales) comme salés (quiches, salades composées, sandwichs,…), tous étant bons et frais. Le personnel est, la majeure partie du temps, agréable et efficace (quelques exceptions à relever). L’établissement propose des paniers « too good to go » à 4€, paniers qui sont toujours très rentables avec une bonne quantité de produits et une variété intéressante (les prix hors too good to go sont un peu élevés, notamment pour les salades qui sont peu garnies).

The lady attending was very rude…

Pain au chocolat was good.

This place is a fairly decent bakery near Gare de Lyon. I got a Pain au Chocolat and a Macaron. The macaron was pretty big, tasted okay, and felt like it had the right texture (a little crumbly outside, then soft). The Pain au Chocolat also tasted like it had a good amount of chocolate, and had a decent texture to it too (crispy exterior, soft inside). They're not the best pastries I've had, even compared to ones I had in the US/Canada/UK, but still good enough to try. And it looks like this is maybe a chain, so it's probably expected.

The customer experience could have been a bit better, as I felt they were getting impatient and rushing with me. But to be fair, they were very to-the-point, and got the transaction done swiftly. Also, perhaps they got impatient because I attempted to speak French (I'm trying to learn), to which they may not have liked how I sounded with it.

I'm open to try this place again for other things they have.

Just outside Gare de Lyon that you can grab a quick bite with various salted and sweet options with fare price. However, the apple pie was too sour and pain au chocolat was too doughy. They were not as good as it looked.
